"PR #3, Gate 5, Ubuntu/Python 3.12: for the approved replay-cli-diagnostic unit case, the command exited 1 and identified usage.json. Its path under /tmp/pytest-of-runner made Rich wrap the phrase \"missing required files\" across lines. Fix only that one existing test. Keep the exit code and absence of a success banner. Require the diagnostic to say missing required files and name usage.json together in the expected missing-file list. Normalize only presentation whitespace. Set a realistic narrow output width with the existing monkeypatch fixture (Rich honors COLUMNS) to exercise wrapping deterministically; do not depend on the exact layout. No changes to application or CI. Return only a JSON object with fields path, old and new, specifying one exact contiguous replacement in this function. No tool calls.

File: test/offline/test_cli_slice.py

def test_cli_replay_incomplete_fails(desk_home, monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    monkeypatch.setenv(\"RESEARCH_DESK_HOME\", desk_home)

    bad = tmp_path / \"bad\"
    shutil.copytree(\"test/fixtures/packs/aapl_buy_complete\", bad)
    (bad / \"usage.json\").unlink()
    r = runner.invoke(app, [\"replay\", str(bad)])
    assert r.exit_code != 0
    assert \"missing required files\" in r.output
    assert \"Replayed\" not in r.output

"

{"path":"test/offline/test_cli_slice.py","old":"    r = runner.invoke(app, ["replay", str(bad)])
    assert r.exit_code != 0
    assert "missing required files" in r.output
    assert "Replayed" not in r.output","new":"    monkeypatch.setenv("COLUMNS", "40")
    r = runner.invoke(app, ["replay", str(bad)])
    assert r.exit_code != 0
    normalized = " ".join(r.output.split())
    assert "missing required files" in normalized
    assert "usage.json" in normalized.split("missing required files", 1)[1]
    assert "Replayed" not in r.output"}
